question: Srinivas Varadhan was awarded the Padma Vibhushan in the year 2023 for exceptional and distinguished service in which field?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Science and Engineering**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Srinivas Varadhan was awarded the Padma Vibhushan in 2023.
 
• He was recognized for his exceptional and distinguished service in the field of Science and Engineering.
 
• The Padma Vibhushan is India's second-highest civilian award.
 
• It is awarded for exceptional and distinguished service in any field including service rendered by Government servants.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Srinivas Varadhan is a renowned Indian-American mathematician.
 
• He is known for his fundamental contributions to probability theory and particularly for creating a unified theory of large deviations.
 
• Varadhan's work has applications in various fields such as quantum field theory, population dynamics, finance, and traffic flow.
 
• He has received several prestigious awards in mathematics, including the Abel Prize in 2007.
 
• Varadhan's contributions have significantly influenced the development of theoretical probability and its applications.
